personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center built for rapid scanning, severe inventory limits, and heavy field operations in harsh warehouse environments.

spacing.rule: Dense tactical layout. Prioritize glanceability over whitespace. Use tight groupings for related metrics.

dont's: No glassmorphism. This is a severe utilitarian environment. Use flat surfaces with precise borders.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure gateway with password + biometric auth for staff/admin.

states.error: Solid red (#FF3B30) banner below inputs with 'Retry'.

screens.layout: Centered industrial login block on surfaceSecondary. Large thumb-friendly inputs. Primary CTA locked to keyboard top or bottom. Face/Touch ID prompt immediately available.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Main command center giving immediate access to company gate filters and the 5 primary modules.

states.error: Error boundary with bold text and reload CTA.

screens.layout: Top sticky row: Company gate toggle (Hyundai/Maruti/Tata/Mahindra/All) using horizontally scrollable chips. Below: 5 large modular tiles (Search, Buy, Sell, Requirement, Buying Trip) arranged in a tactical grid (2 columns, last one spans full width). Offline sync indicator pill fixed at top right.

screens.name: Universal Scanner
screens.purpose: High-throughput barcode/QR/photo scanning interface with live overlays.

states.loading: Camera initializing state with centered bracket.
states.error: Camera permission error with large settings CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. Central high-contrast targeting bracket. Bottom drawer handles scanner history or manual entry toggle. Live status overlay floats at bottom showing last scanned result (e.g., 'IN STOCK', 'KNOWN PART') with strong haptics.

screens.name: Search Result / Part Master
screens.purpose: Dense informational breakdown of a scanned part, including AI confidence and technical limits.

states.loading: Skeleton layout matching the complex technical grid.
states.empty: Illustration of empty shelf + 'Part Not Found' + 'Add New Part' CTA.
states.error: Warning banner indicating corrupted part data or network failure.

screens.layout: Top section: 6-side photo gallery (horizontal scroll). Mid section: Part Number in Barlow Condensed (huge), Status chips (IN STOCK/REQUIREMENT). AI Research Result card: Confidence meter (horizontal bar), Conflict Warning (if Gemini data mismatches). Admin-only price row (toggled via icon). Bottom sticky CTA: 'Proceed to Buy/Sell'.

screens.name: Buy Flow (Purchase Limit)
screens.purpose: Strict buying interface enforcing admin purchase limits via visual meters.

states.error: Limit exceeded error with DO NOT BUY banner.

screens.layout: Persistent Purchase Limit meter at the top (Stacked horizontal bar: Existing Stock [Grey] + Current Purchase [Amber] + Allowed Limit [Border line]). If purchase exceeds limit, the entire screen border turns solid red, and a massive 'DO NOT BUY' banner locks the primary CTA.

screens.name: Category Master
screens.purpose: Hierarchical catalog of 73 items across 5 groups.
screens.layout: SectionList pattern. 5 collapsible groups. Each row has a high-contrast label and a tight bounding box. Use sharp dividers instead of cards. Fast alphabetical scroll index on the right edge.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. Do not use glassmorphism, blur, or soft shadows. Use hard borders, high-contrast dividers, and flat surfaces.
BANNED COLORS: Strictly NO blue, indigo, violet, or purple. For Info/Known parts, use the defined `info` token (#9E9E9E Silver).

Typography: Use `Barlow Condensed` for all part numbers, metrics, scores, and limits to pack data densely. Use `IBM Plex Sans` for body text, which handles the Gujarati script gracefully on Android while maintaining an industrial B2B look.

Purchase Limit Engine: Implement a horizontal stacked progress bar. Existing stock is dark grey (`surfaceTertiary`), Current purchase is `brandPrimary` (amber). If Allowed Limit is exceeded, trigger the DO-NOT-BUY state: disable the Buy CTA, show a full-width `error` (#FF3B30) banner, and trigger heavy haptics.

Scanner Overlay: Ensure oversized touch targets ('gloved hands' principle). Provide immediate visual and haptic feedback on scan. Do not rely solely on color; use bold text ('IN STOCK', 'DO NOT BUY').

AI Research Result Card: Display Gemini AI confidence using a horizontal progress bar. If there's an 'Information Conflict', show a prominent `warning` (#FFCC00) chip alongside Admin Approve/Reject buttons.
Company Gate: Use a horizontal scrollable chip row for brand filtering (Hyundai/Maruti/Tata/Mahindra/All) at the top of the Home Dashboard. Ensure the active chip is `brandPrimary`.
Offline-First: Show a persistent offline sync indicator pill at the top of the Home Dashboard. All lists must support background sync without blocking the UI.
Ensure the layout relies on spacing, 1pt structural borders (`borderStrong`), and tonal shifts instead of shadows.
Component detail: Buttons should be flat, pill-shaped or rounded (`md`), using `brandPrimary` with `onBrandPrimary` (black text) for maximum contrast. No gradients.
